extension.name: Security Review
extension.description: Full-project secure-by-design security audits plus staged, branch/PR, plan, task, follow-up, and apply reviews
extension.author: DyanGalih

commands.name: speckit.security-review.audit
commands.description: Performs broader or full-system security review across the codebase. Recommended for milestone reviews, release reviews, or major architecture validation.

commands.name: speckit.security-review.staged
commands.description: Security review of staged changes only (git diff --cached)

commands.name: speckit.security-review.branch
commands.description: Reviews security risks introduced by the current branch or implementation changes. Recommended for normal feature development workflows.

commands.name: speckit.security-review.plan
commands.description: Security review of Spec-Kit plan artifacts and supporting design docs

commands.name: speckit.security-review.tasks
commands.description: Security review of Spec-Kit task artifacts and implementation sequencing

commands.name: speckit.security-review.followup
commands.description: Create remediation plans or technical-debt tasks from security review findings

commands.name: speckit.security-review.apply
commands.description: Apply approved security follow-up items into tasks.md and plan.md

commands.name: speckit.security-review.export
commands.description: Export security review findings as a formal Executive and Technical Pentest Report.

commands.name: speckit.security-review.verify
commands.description: Re-verify security findings against source code, classify exploitability, and generate safe Proof-of-Concept (PoC) reproductions.

commands.name: speckit.security-review.init
commands.description: Initialize or update the Project Security Constitution.

hooks.prompt: Would you like to perform a security review on the proposed technical plan?
Would you like to verify that security boundaries are represented in the tasks?
Would you like to scan the new implementation for security vulnerabilities?
